'''Androclus Methodius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who came to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to work for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in cleaning up local [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] wildlife.<ref name="TOR" />
